questions.text: First up: what mattress size are you leaning toward?

For motion, which setup sounds closest to what you want? Standard Motion (one mattress and base that move together), Half Split Motion (head can move separately while feet stay in sync; available in Queen and King, and only with the Dual Comfort), Full Split Motion (head and feet move separately on each side; available in King setups), or No Motion (standard platform, storage base, highrise frame, or mattress only).
Do you regularly share the bed with a partner?
How do you mostly sleep: on your side, back, stomach, or a mix?
How sensitive are you to movement in the bed?
options: Medium — I notice it but can deal with it
High — I wake up easily from movement

questions.text: Do you usually sleep hot, cold, or pretty neutral at night?
If you had to choose, do you lean soft, medium, or firm for comfort?
Do you personally snore or use a CPAP / sleep apnea device?
Any back pain, pressure points, or other issues you hope the mattress can help with? (Choose all that apply or skip if none.)
How does your partner mostly sleep: on their side, back, stomach, or a mix?
How sensitive is your partner to movement in the bed?
options: Medium — they notice it but can deal with it
High — they wake up easily from movement

questions.text: Does your partner usually sleep hot, cold, or neutral at night?
